sets.title: Two different sports — understand the context

items.explanation: The second sentence describes Emma, not Liam.

reviewCard.maltese: Emma tipprattika t-tenis nhar ta' Ħadd.

sets.title: Nina's weekly timetable — understand the context

items.prompt: Use Nina's timetable. When is her Maltese lesson?
items.explanation: Read across the Monday row to connect the lesson with its time.

reviewCard.maltese: It-Tnejn Nina għandha lezzjoni tal-Malti fl-erbgħa.
reviewCard.english: On Monday Nina has a Maltese lesson at four.

items.prompt: On which day is Nina's piano lesson? Answer with the Maltese weekday.
items.explanation: The piano lesson is in the Thursday row.

reviewCard.english: On Thursday Nina has a piano lesson.

items.prompt: Which activity starts earliest in the afternoon?
items.explanation: 15:30 is earlier in the afternoon than 16:00 and 17:00.

reviewCard.maltese: Il-lezzjoni tal-pjanu tibda fit-tlieta u nofs.
reviewCard.english: The piano lesson starts at half past three.

items.prompt: Nina's three activities are on three different days.
items.explanation: The timetable lists Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.

reviewCard.maltese: Nina għandha attivitajiet it-Tnejn, it-Tlieta u l-Ħamis.
reviewCard.english: Nina has activities on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.

items.prompt: What does Rita eat at this festa? Answer in Maltese.
